_: pochoir task13 FINE geometry (LArPix v2a, 4.4 mm pitch, no shield grid, 150.6 mm drift) solved by this package for comparison with pochoir and firep.
_inputs: the pochoir drift and weighting JSON exactly as pochoir reads them (copied from pochoir/scripts at commit 9d9cd36); spacing is the pochoir grid spacing they are written for (pochoir's --spacing, not a config key)
_mesh: h_min = spacing / 2**refine; refine 0 reproduces pochoir's anode node-for-node, refine 1 halves h_min. grade: cell size ~ distance_to_anode/grade. max_root: largest root cell of the weighting tree (the drift tile's root is fixed by its 4.4 mm period)
_export: fields resampled on pochoir's lattice, mm above the anode (null = up to the cathode)
_drift: pochoir run-pixel-field.sh settings: BNL mobility at 87 K, 0..200 us in 0.05 us ticks; the impact grid follows Npixels as pochoir induce-pixel does
